description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Persuade vs. Riddle against a creature within long range. On a win, the target is charmed by you, its eyes glow a color of your choosing and your roll result becomes the Difficulty.

At the start of each of the creature's turns, you may spend a reaction. If you do, the creature must spend an action to make a melee attack against a creature you mentally designate. After resolving this attack, the target may roll Awareness against the Difficulty, ending the effect on a pass.

Describe the change that comes over them.
successes:
✨: Win or loss, the creature checks a Condition.

🌞: When you spend a reaction to force the creature to make an attack, you may also force it to move in a direction of your choosing, up to half its Speed.
name: Madness
